title: 10/10 Flamenco Experience 💃
text: We had so much fun going to Poble Espanol and Tablao de Carmen. The performers were all exceptional, the venue was intimate and welcoming. We sat right by the stage but there wasn’t a bad seat in the house. Everyone was very friendly. The food and wine was plentiful. I would recommend this to others. We are so glad we went, a highlight of our trip!
author: Nancy_C

title: Recommend this dinner/show
text: We very much enjoyed the show. And the dinner was quite tasty. it was nice to be able to spend some time in the Spanish Village before the show.
author: Nancy_B

title: Great performances!...
text: Great performances! Definitely recommend coming a little early to check out the rest of the area…lots to see
author: JonelleGulston

title: Experience was great....
text: Experience was great. Show was great! The food wasn’t very good. Staff was wonderful. Seating arrangements were perfect to view show
author: sterling_r

title: A fantastic dinner experience
text: The dancing was fantastic. The show was really good. We all enjoyed it and the meal was superb. I highly recommend the filet mignon.
author: KDMulloy

title: Danced out off his shoe!
text:
Show was amazing! The young man that performed danced so hard he broke his shoe!!
Dinner was good, drinks were great!
author: Brandy_K

title: Flamenco
text: Make sure to allow time to walk the village.  Limited choices on menu, but was tasty any plenty. Enjoyed the performance immensely.
author: Annette_A

title: Wonderful Show and Dinner
text: The Flamenco Show and dinner were wonderful! The dancing was very vibrant and delightful. The food was very good with unlimited Sangria. It was a highlight of our trip.
author: suejB4267FE

title: Great evening
text: Food and performance were really extraordinarily good. Can only recommend this evening.
author: E2004XCjorgef

title: Lively Evening of Flamenco!
text: We really enjoyed our evening at Tablao de Carmen!  Both the food and drink were generous and delicious. The singers and dancers showed great passion for their art. It was also fun when two of their daughters came out and danced at the end of the evening!
author: Margot_H
